text: This might be a silly one, I'm fairly new to fostering and just want to check. I've got a little boy of 2 with me, temp 38.3 this evening. He's had runny poo a few times today. He's drinking really well though and his nappies have been wet as normal. When his ibuprofen is working he's running about, playing with the cars and chatting away. Is this ok to manage at home?
